cases.name: Lila Wilson
cases.about:
Lila Wilson was a beloved member of the Seattle dance music community, according to a GoFundMe page set up by friends in her honor.

"Lila was known for her ready smile that would light up a room, her fierce dancing, and as a warrior for those who needed help most, including migrant families and those in marginalized communities," the GoFundMe says. "She was a gorgeous soul, and so many of us are in shock with her passing."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her 6 times to her head, face, thigh and abdomen in front of her wailing 14-month-old baby.
